output.summary: The denial rests on the experimental service exclusion in the V2024 policy. You must provide a genetic counselor referral, but the claim is currently blocked by an exclusion gate.

items.text: Submit a referral from a qualified genetic counselor to document medical necessity for the genetic test.
The bariatric precedent does not apply because the denial is based on an experimental service exclusion, not a bariatric service, and the governing clause differs from the current policy version.
The genetic testing precedent is irrelevant since it was derived under a later policy version (C-2025-GENETIC-TEST) and does not govern the current V2024 policy.
The claim is blocked by the EXCLUSION_NO_BASIS gate, meaning there is presently no permissible basis to appeal the denial.
